confirmedRules: Keep browsed month/filter while open across month boundary
Recompute purchase/voluntary-refund eligibility from current computer date/timezone; no permanent cutoff lock; cancelled/final-result guards retained
Bank day follows timezone fixed on first shop activation, independent of later computer timezone

implementation.calendar: Local minute-aligned timeout plus focus/pageshow/visibility recheck refreshes today marker/date grouping on signature change; no navigation, source fetching or persisted cutoff flags
implementation.bank: bankTimeZone stored once at activation; accrual uses that zone and bankAnchorDay; bank UI shows fixed zone
implementation.reuse: Existing dateInZone, eligibility, bank day arithmetic and game UI; no added dependency

limitations: No automated browser rendering, geometry or native macOS lifecycle checks
In-memory prototype resets on reload; formal account/cache persistence not implemented
Current-date policy can reopen date eligibility after rollback when no final/cancelled state prohibits it; intentionally not strict anti-cheat
Fixed bank timezone does not provide a trusted external clock; forward clock tampering is outside this design guarantee
Actual native-window experience explicitly deferred by user; real regional data audit is next
